column3: Annual Conference 2026 · Harbourside Civic Centre · 6–7 November
Welcome to the second annual conference of the Northshore Library Network. This year’s theme is reading in a changing community.

Lunch is served in the Atrium from 12:30.

Step-free access from the Quay Street entrance.
